parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of gender expression, no documented police targeting, border, facility or custody exposure, and formal anti-discrimination and hate-crime protections exist. However the dossier documents no trans-specific social acceptance; instead public attitudes discourage LGBT expression, faith and opposition pressure removed constitutional protection, and enforcement is slow and uneven with few concluded complaints and only one mediated ruling in favour. The ten logged violence cases cannot be assessed without a background homicide rate. This is documented social hostility with thin, unproven recourse, well above universal-exposure or targeting tiers but below jurisdictions with demonstrated acceptance and working remedies.
